description: We are Astra Hexa, a passionate, multidisciplinary team of creators, innovators, and space enthusiasts. Bringing together diverse skills across art, design, technology, and software development, we blend creativity with technical expertise to turn bold ideas into impactful solutions. Driven by our fascination with space, we tackle complex challenges at the intersection of space data, design, and technology and imagine new possibilities for exploring the universe.
summary: Our project is an educational story about NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. Through the adventures of Lily, a young astronaut, and her AI companion, Luna, we explore six groups of machines left behind during past space missions. The story explains what each machine was designed to do, how it worked, what scientists discovered, and what happened after its mission ended. By combining storytelling with science, we make space exploration interesting and easy to understand for all audiences. Our project shows that even when machines stop working, the knowledge they leave behind continues to help humanity understand space.
details:
Secret Beyond Earth is an interactive, story-driven educational project inspired by NASA’s Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge, designed to introduce students and space enthusiasts to NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars. The project follows a young astronaut named Lily and her AI companion, Luna, as they explore these worlds to uncover the history, functions, and scientific contributions of six groups of space machines.

By replacing complicated technical jargon with storytelling and interactive digital content, the project makes learning about space exploration much more accessible and enjoyable for younger audiences. This narrative-first approach naturally sparks curiosity and helps students better understand complex scientific concepts.

Ultimately, our goal is to inspire the next generation to pursue space science, technology, and exploration. We want to raise awareness of NASA's past missions and show how discoveries from completed expeditions continue to shape our understanding of the universe and guide future space travel.

To bring this experience to life, our team combined reliable research with modern digital tools. We gathered accurate historical and scientific data directly from official NASA resources, used Gemini and AI to brainstorm and organise our ideas, built the interactive educational modules in Genially, and edited our visual storytelling elements using CapCut.

Secret Beyond Earth is innovative because it seamlessly blends fictional adventure with real-world science. Instead of presenting a dry list of facts, we use Lily and Luna to guide the audience through an imaginative journey where they actively discover each machine’s legacy as the plot unfolds.

Throughout development, we balanced scientific accuracy with age-appropriate language, appealing visuals, and interactive elements to keep the project engaging and easy to follow. Overall, Secret Beyond Earth transforms the stories of forgotten space hardware into a memorable learning experience, reminding us that even when a machine’s mission ends, its contributions to science last forever.
